note: This file is a declarative configuration file for the MMDetection/MMPretrain framework. It contains no functions, classes, methods, or argparse CLI entry points — only model parameter assignments (backbone CSPNeXt P5 with widen_factor=0.5, LinearClsHead with 1000 classes, LabelSmoothLoss, Mixup/CutMix augments, and a 600-epoch cosine annealing schedule) that are consumed by the MMDetection training pipeline. Per guidelines, files without callable code or CLI modules are excluded.
